A binary function from [0,1] × [0,1] to [0,1], which, when given (a,b) as input, returns one minus a t-norm of (1 − a, 1 − b).
ex: The t-conorm #92;sqrt#123;x²#43;y²-x²y²#125; is dominated by the t-conorm x#43;y-xy, which is in turn dominated by the t-conorm #123;x#43;y#92;over 1#43;xy#125;.

A t-conorm acts as a disjunction in fuzzy logic or as a union in fuzzy set theory. When one of its arguments is 0, it returns its other argument; when one of its arguments is 1, it returns 1. It is both associative and c
